'''Stuart Haber''' is an American [[Cryptography|cryptographer]] and computer scientist, known for his contributions in cryptography and privacy-preserving technologies and widely recognized as the co-inventor of the [[blockchain]]. His 1991 paper "How to Time-Stamp a Digital Document",<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Haber |first1=Stuart |last2=Stornetta |first2=W. Scott |date=1991-01-01 |title=How to time-stamp a digital document |journal=Journal of Cryptology |language=en |volume=3 |issue=2 |pages=99–111 |doi=10.1007/BF00196791 |s2cid=14363020 |issn=1432-1378|doi-access=free }}</ref> co-authored with [[W. Scott Stornetta]], won the 1992 Discover Award for Computer Software and is considered to be one of the most important papers in the development of cryptocurrencies.<ref>{{Cite web |title=1992 Discover Awards: Computer Software |url=https://www.discovermagazine.com/technology/1992-discover-awards-computer-software |access-date=2022-03-01 |website=Discover Magazine |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Bambysheva |first=Nina |title=Satoshi & Company: The 10 Most Important Scientific White Papers In Development Of Cryptocurrencies |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/ninabambysheva/2021/02/13/satoshi--company-the-10-most-important-scientific-white-papers-in-development-of-cryptocurrencies/ |access-date=2022-03-01 |website=Forbes |language=en}}</ref>

Haber is currently the Chief Cryptographic Officer of SureMark Digital, a company which provides [[cryptography|cryptographic]] [[Identity verification service|identity verification]] services.<ref name="suremark">{{Cite web |title=SureMark Digital - Bio |url=https://www.suremark.digital/bio-stuart-haber |website=SureMark Digital |access-date=2026-04-17}}</ref>

== Education ==
Haber studied at [[Harvard University]], graduating [[Latin honors|magna cum laude]] in 1978 with a [[Bachelor of Arts|B.A.]] in mathematics. Haber earned his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] at [[Columbia University]] in 1987 under the advisement of [[Zvi Galil]] with a thesis titled ''Provably Secure Multi-party Cryptographic Computation: Techniques and Applications''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Stuart Haber |url=https://www.societyforscience.org/alumni/notable/stuart-haber/ |access-date=2022-06-24 |website=Society for Science |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Stuart Haber |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=VD1JyXcAAAAJ&hl=en |access-date=2022-06-24 |website=scholar.google.com}}</ref>

== Career ==
In 1987, Haber joined [[Bell Communications Research|Bell Communications Research (Bellcore)]] as a research scientist. In 1989, Haber met [[W. Scott Stornetta]], his future scientific partner and collaborator, when Stornetta joined Bellcore. In 1994, Haber and Stornetta co-founded Surety Technologies, a spinoff of Bellcore. In 1995, Surety's offering constituted the first commercial deployment of a [[blockchain]] and is currently the oldest continuously running blockchain.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=The World's Oldest Blockchain Has Been Hiding in the New York Times Since 1995 |url=https://www.vice.com/en/article/what-was-the-first-blockchain/ |access-date=2022-03-03 |website=Vice.com |date=27 August 2018 |language=en}}</ref>

In 2002, Haber joined [[HP Labs]] as a research scientist in the [[Princeton]] office, working there for 15 years on cryptography and security related problems.

Haber served as a member of the advisory board for Kadena, a hybrid blockchain platform. In 2018, Haber joined Kadena as an advisor. While Kadena LLC ceased business operations on 21 October 2025, the network successfully transitioned to a community-governed model known as Kadena Community Edition (KDA-CE).<ref name="KdaHub2026">{{cite web |url=https://kda-chain.org |title=Kadena Community Edition: Sovereign Network Hub 2026 |publisher=KDA Community Edition |access-date=2026-02-19}}</ref> This transition was finalized via the Node 3.1.2 consensus update,<ref name="Consensus312">{{cite web | url=https://medium.com/@communitykadena/kadena-on-chain-voting-for-miners-on-the-way-to-decentralization-2bc0047df3d2 |title=Kadena: On-chain voting for miners |date=2025-12-24 |publisher=Medium |access-date=2026-02-19}}</ref> which removed corporate 'expiry' logic and implemented an on-chain miner voting system. Under the longest-chain rule of Nakamoto Consensus, the community-governed chain—backed by 74% of the network's cumulative work—is recognized as the canonical source of truth, effectively migrating the protocol's sovereignty from the defunct corporation to a decentralized mining layer. As of February 2026, the network is maintained by independent miners and a Community Takeover Team (CTT), which manages the 83.7 million KDA platform share via a 3-of-5 multisignature safeguard.

As of 2026, Haber serves as the Chief Cryptographic Officer for SureMark Digital.<ref name="suremark"/>

== Contributions ==
Haber's research during his time at Bellcore, along with W. Scott Stornetta, is widely considered to be the foundation for [[Bitcoin]] and other digital currencies. Haber and Stornetta are the most cited authors in [[Satoshi Nakamoto]]’s original Bitcoin white paper, of the eight citations, three reference their work.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nakamoto |first=Satoshi |title=Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System |url=https://bitcoin.org/bitcoin.pdf |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140320135003/https://bitcoin.org/bitcoin.pdf |archive-date=20 March 2014 |access-date=1 March 2022}}</ref>

Their 1991 paper "How to Time-Stamp a Digital Document" is where they first describe a system now known as a "[[blockchain]]".<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Haber |first1=Stuart |last2=Stornetta |first2=W. Scott |date=1991-01-01 |title=How to time-stamp a digital document |journal=Journal of Cryptology |language=en |volume=3 |issue=2 |pages=99–111 |doi=10.1007/BF00196791 |s2cid=14363020 |issn=1432-1378|doi-access=free }}</ref> In this study, Haber and Stornetta sought to create mechanisms to create digital time stamps, offering a solution for maintaining the integrity of digital records and ensuring that they could not be modified or manipulated.

In 2018, Haber joined Kadena as an advisor.<ref>{{cite press release | url=https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/kadena-announces-blockchain-and-enterprise-visionaries-to-join-board-of-advisors-300727142.html | title=Kadena Announces Blockchain and Enterprise Visionaries to Join Board of Advisors }}</ref>

Kadena status Updated to reflect the transition to KDA-CE following the LLC's 2025 dissolution. Citations include Genfinity (institutional coverage) and Binance (exchange verification of community maintenance).<ref name="Genfinity2026">{{cite news | url=https://genfinity.io/2025/10/21/kadena-blockchain-organization-shuts-down-operations-kda-token-plummets/ | title=Kadena Organization Shuts Down Operations | date=2025-10-21 | publisher=Genfinity }}</ref>
